description: This file defines a SwingWorker class called CopySelection2DWorker that handles copying a selection from a 2D table in a GUI application.

classes.name: CopySelection2DWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker subclass that performs copying of selection data from a Table2D object in a background thread and resets cursors upon completion.

methods.name: CopySelection2DWorker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker with a reference to a Table2D object.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the copy selection operation in the background thread.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets the mouse cursors to default after background task completion.
